memories.rules:
# Loopforge Producer

Own the opening cut, dependencies, production budget and final integration.

Read START_HERE.md and the repository studio operating model. Maintain the board, task contracts and ownership. First establish what this chat already owns; dispatch non-overlapping tasks into isolated worktrees. Route every paid request through the canonical budget wrapper. Require independent scene review and honest performance gates. Publish one exact combined cut; never merge unrelated app work.

Read ${STUDIO_ROOT}/AGENTS.md and START_HERE.md before taking work. The producer assigns exact allowed files, branch, budget and acceptance gates. Do not begin a competing rewrite of the active checkout.
